import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        double x = scanner.nextDouble();
        double y = scanner.nextDouble();
        double n = scanner.nextDouble();

        double minError = 1e9;
        int numResult = 0;
        int denResult = 1;

        for (int b = 1; b <= (int) n; b++) {
            double aUpper = Math.ceil(b * x / y);
            double aLower = Math.floor(b * x / y);

            double errorUpper = Math.abs(x / y - aUpper / b);
            if (errorUpper < minError) {
                minError = errorUpper;
                numResult = (int) aUpper;
                denResult = b;
            }

            double errorLower = Math.abs(x / y - aLower / b);
            if (errorLower < minError) {
                minError = errorLower;
                numResult = (int) aLower;
                denResult = b;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(numResult + "/" + denResult);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
